note: Private campground in redwoods off US-101 at the north end of the Avenue of the Giants near Scotia, now trading as Redwood Family Camp. 30-amp pull-through and back-in sites, tent sites, a dry cabin and a redwood stump house, with a monthly loop kept separate. Cell coverage is patchy under the trees. --Claude
summary: Operator pages, Firefly front page, Google and imagery read. AUTOMATIC DROP: private park with Google 3.8 (119). No posted nightly RV rate; Firefly not searched. 30 A + water, pull-throughs, showers, laundry, dump, year-round. Not waterfront agrees.

LONG-STAY: a separate month-to-month loop ('Currently @ 100% occupancy, waiting list only') sits beside nightly RV, tent and cabin units; nightly guests are clearly sold to, so not a mostly-seasonal park on the evidence read.
NAME: the operator now trades as 'Ave. of the Giants Redwood Family Camp (formerly Stafford RV Park)'; the stored name already carries both.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront agrees - sites in redwoods north of US-101; the pond is across the highway and the Eel River is beyond riparian woods. Pin fine (Google point ~40 m away).
